content_sections.heading: ITBP Constable (GD) Sports Quota Selection Process & Marking Scheme
content_sections.text: Selection follows: Documentation → Physical Standard Test (PST) → Sports Trial Test (qualifying) → Merit List (based on sports achievement marks) → Detailed Medical Examination (DME) → Review Medical Examination (RME), if required. There is no written examination. The official notification lists 18 competition tiers in total (including Youth Olympics, World Championship Quadrennial/Biennial, Junior World Championship, Asian Championship Quadrennial/Biennial/Annual, Junior Asian Championship, World University Games, and other MYA&S-cleared international events). Candidates get marks for only the single highest medal/participation secured in the 01.01.2024–01.11.2026 window. Documentation: Verification of original certificates (age, education, caste, sports achievement); identity/biometric verification is mandatory Physical Standard Test (PST): Height, chest (male only) and weight checked against the standards above; over/underweight candidates are not debarred at this stage – final fitness decision rests with the Medical Officer at DME Sports Trial Test: 40 marks, qualifying in nature, minimum cut-off 20 marks (does not count toward final merit); exempted for candidates who represented India in an International Sports Event with Department of Sports clearance No appeal is entertained for re-conduct of the Sports Trial Test Final merit is based purely on the sports achievement marking scheme (Documentation + PST + Sports Trial marks are not added to merit, only used for shortlisting/qualifying) Tie-break order: (1) higher marks, (2) higher National-competition achievement if International achievements are equal, (3) younger candidate, (4) alphabetical order of name in English Detailed Medical Examination (DME) conducted per MHA's Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination (dated 20.05.2015, as amended) Candidates declared unfit may opt for Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours; the RME decision is final Pregnant female candidates are declared temporarily unfit; their vacancy is held and they are re-examined 6 weeks after confinement, subject to a fitness certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITBP Constable (GD) Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in and create a candidate profile with a genuine, active e-mail ID and mobile number. Upload a copy of the certificate/document supporting your highest medal/position or highest level of sports participation in the advertised duration before applying – applications without this are rejected during scrutiny. Complete the online application form carefully. Pay the application fee online, if applicable to your category. Submit before the closing date: 01 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Offline applications are summarily rejected. Important: Fee once paid is non-refundable, and payment via any mode other than the ITBPF website leads to summary rejection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th class certificate (proof of date of birth) Sports achievement certificate(s), signed by the competent awarding authority (National Federation Secretary, IOA, University Dean of Sports, or SAI, depending on the competition level) OBC certificate (Annexure-III) with Non-Creamy-Layer declaration (Annexure-III(A)), SC/ST certificate (Annexure-IV), or EWS certificate valid for 2025-26 (Annexure-V), as applicable No Objection Certificate (Annexure-II), for candidates in Government service Certificate for height/chest relaxation (Annexure-VI), if claiming this relaxation Domicile certificate issued by local revenue authorities (special format, Annexure-VI(A), for West Pakistani Refugees in J&K/Ladakh) Four latest passport-size photographs (same as used in the online application)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: These vacancies are not open to physically challenged persons or ex-servicemen Selected candidates must serve a minimum of 10 years in the Force; resigning earlier requires refunding 3 months' pay/allowances or training cost, whichever is higher No TA/DA is admissible for travel to/from the recruitment venue; candidates should be prepared for a multi-day stay at their own arrangement and cost Possession of mobile phones, firearms, or any gadget at the recruitment venue, impersonation, forged documents, or misbehaviour with recruitment staff leads to cancellation of candidature and possible police/legal action Admit cards are issued only online; ITBPF is not responsible for non-receipt due to invalid contact details or technical issues ITBPF reserves the right to change the recruitment procedure, cancel or postpone recruitment, or transfer unfilled vacancies between disciplines/categories

faq.question: Q1. What is ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment by Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP) to fill 126 vacancies of Constable (General Duty), Group 'C' Non-Gazetted and Non-Ministerial, under the Sports Quota for meritorious sportspersons.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 126 vacancies in total, including 72 for male candidates and 54 for female candidates across 28 sports disciplines. The vacancies are tentative and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Online applications start on 3 October 2026 at 00:01 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 23 years. Meritorious sportspersons get an upper age relaxation of up to 5 years, and up to 10 years for SC/ST candidates, subject to the conditions in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100/- for male candidates in the UR, OBC and EWS categories. Females, ex-servicemen, and SC and ST candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official ITBP recruitment website, https://recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in, between 3 October 2026 and 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The selection stages are not specified in the Employment News notice. They are given in the detailed advertisement, and ITBP may change the sequence of the process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level-3 with a pay range of Rs. 21,700 to Rs. 69,100.
